## Apple Inc. — Q1 2026 Research Note

Apple reported revenue of $124.3 billion for Q1 2026, up 4% year-over-year.
Services revenue reached a record $26.3 billion, driven by the App Store, Apple TV+, and iCloud subscriptions.
iPhone revenue came in at $69.1 billion, slightly ahead of consensus estimates of $67.8 billion.

Gross margin expanded 80 basis points to 46.9%, reflecting continued mix shift toward higher-margin Services.
Management guided Q2 revenue in the range of $88–92 billion, implying low-single-digit growth on a constant currency basis.

Recommendation: Maintain Overweight. Target price $245, based on a 28x forward P/E multiple applied to our FY2027 EPS estimate of $8.75.
